articles.summary: At Bankjoy, we believe the future of community finance lies in embracing cutting-edge technology to solve real problems. That's why we recently hosted our inaugural AI Code Fest – a ‘hackathon’ that challenged our talented product and engineering teams to explore how artificial intelligence could revolutionize the banking experience for community financial institutions.
articles.title: Fighting Fraud, Streamlining Loans & Optimizing Banking: Inside Bankjoy's First AI Code Fest
